policy.purpose: Context supplied to NoteCard extraction; never a text replacement table.

entries.description: The user's voice-note and personal-memory application/project.
entries.apply_when: The surrounding text describes this app, its project, notes, recording, transcription, HUD, windows, or features.
entries.preserve_when: There is independent editor-specific evidence for the real Vim editor, such as Neovim, .vimrc, modal command/insert modes, or Vim plugins.
entries.forbidden_inference: Do not add 'text editor' merely because the surface form is Vim.

entries.description: The app's heads-up recording and transcription panel.
entries.apply_when: The context describes the app UI, recording, transcription, clicking, display, minimization, or a floating window.
entries.preserve_when: The token is an unrelated word such as хадж, English had, or the speaker retracts it in a self-correction.
entries.forbidden_inference: Never invent an expansion such as 'Хранилище Аналитических Данных' unless those words independently occur in the source.
